desc: Kannawa has a secret: Even though she has a reputation in the office as intense, strict, and scary, she’s actually just…awkward. So, when she learns she has to train Kamegawa, the cute, nerdy newbie, she’s at a complete loss! Can this awkward senpai figure out how to handle her budding feelings?! (S
